rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: BRIstep
Exhibition name: Steppin' Out
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dennis A. Bridges (United States, 1995).
Introduced in United States by Bridges Roses Archive - Closed Nursery in 1995 as 'Steppin' Out'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Strong fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Average diameter 2.75". Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes: One of the first large roses developed by Dennis Bridges.
